title: judgment-backend
objective: The judgment model behind the ST server plugin: reachable with a key, off by default, deciding speaker direction when opted in, falling back to today's chain on a timeout, recorded in its own ring, and never leaking the key.

checks.goal: the server plugin answers /status with a configured key, and reports where the key came from without the key itself

steps.eval: const headers = SillyTavern.getContext().getRequestHeaders(); const response = await fetch('/api/plugins/story-orchestrator-judge/status', { headers }).catch(() => null); if (!response) throw new Error('no response from the judge plugin route'); if (response.status === 404) throw new Error('judge plugin not loaded: install it with npm run plugin:install and start ST with enableServerPlugins: true'); const body = await response.json(); globalThis.__soJ11PluginStatus = body; if (!body.configured) throw new Error(`plugin loaded but no key: ${JSON.stringify(body)}`); if (JSON.stringify(body).length > 200) throw new Error('status body unexpectedly large'); return body;

checks.goal: judge off (the default): a real group turn is decided by today's chain and nothing reaches the plugin

steps.eval: const settings = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getGlobalSettings().judge; if (settings.enabled || Object.values(settings.uses).some(Boolean)) throw new Error(`judge not off by default: ${JSON.stringify(settings)}`); globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.setTalkDirectionEnabled(true); globalThis.__soJ11PluginCalls = 0; if (!globalThis.__soJ11FetchWrapped) { const original = globalThis.fetch; globalThis.fetch = (input, init) => { if (String(input?.url ?? input).includes('/api/plugins/story-orchestrator-judge/systemone')) globalThis.__soJ11PluginCalls += 1; return original(input, init); }; globalThis.__soJ11FetchWrapped = true; } return settings;

send_generate.text: I lean on the counter and ask what this job actually pays.

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const decision = rt.getTalkState().decisions.at(-1); if (!['mention', 'director', 'rules', 'fallback'].includes(decision.source)) throw new Error(`judge off but source was ${decision.source}`); if (globalThis.__soJ11PluginCalls !== 0) throw new Error(`${globalThis.__soJ11PluginCalls} plugin calls with the judge off`); const ring = rt.getSessionJournal().filter((event) => event.kind === 'judge'); if (ring.length) throw new Error(`judge ring not empty: ${JSON.stringify(ring)}`); return decision;

checks.goal: judge on with speaker direction opted in: the judge decides the turn inside its budget, records the answering model in its own ring, and adds nothing to the persisted journal

steps.eval: const root = SillyTavern.getContext().extensionSettings['story-orchestrator']; root.settings.judge = { ...root.settings.judge, enabled: true, timeoutMs: 1500, uses: { ...root.settings.judge.uses, director: true } }; globalThis.storyOrchestratorJudge.invalidateStatus(); globalThis.__soJ11JournalBefore = SillyTavern.getContext().chatMetadata.story_orchestrator?.stories?.[SillyTavern.getContext().chatMetadata.story_orchestrator.selectedStoryId]?.extras?.journal?.length ?? 0; return globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getGlobalSettings().judge;

send_generate.text: I turn to the old man behind the job board: what is the pay for the Sun Ruins?

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const decision = rt.getTalkState().decisions.at(-1); if (decision.source !== 'judge') throw new Error(`expected a judge decision, got ${JSON.stringify(decision)}`); if (decision.latencyMs > 1500) throw new Error(`judge decision took ${decision.latencyMs} ms`); const calls = rt.getSessionJournal().filter((event) => event.kind === 'judge'); const last = calls.at(-1); if (!last || !String(last.detail?.model ?? '').startsWith('jev-')) throw new Error(`no judge record with a model: ${JSON.stringify(calls)}`); if (globalThis.__soJ11PluginCalls < 1) throw new Error('the judge decided without a plugin call'); const meta = SillyTavern.getContext().chatMetadata.story_orchestrator; const journal = meta.stories[meta.selectedStoryId].extras.journal ?? []; if (journal.some((record) => record.kind === 'judge')) throw new Error('judge rows leaked into the persisted journal'); return { decision, record: last, pluginCalls: globalThis.__soJ11PluginCalls };

checks.goal: a 1 ms judge budget falls back to today's chain, records the fallback, and the turn still gets a reply

steps.eval: const root = SillyTavern.getContext().extensionSettings['story-orchestrator']; root.settings.judge = { ...root.settings.judge, timeoutMs: 1 }; globalThis.__soJ11ChatBefore = SillyTavern.getContext().chat.length; return root.settings.judge.timeoutMs;

send_generate.text: Arin, you have been quiet. What do you make of the sphinx story?

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const decision = rt.getTalkState().decisions.at(-1); if (decision.source === 'judge') throw new Error('a 1 ms budget still produced a judge decision'); const last = rt.getSessionJournal().filter((event) => event.kind === 'judge').at(-1); if (!last?.summary.includes('fell back (timeout)')) throw new Error(`no timeout fallback recorded: ${JSON.stringify(last)}`); if (SillyTavern.getContext().chat.length <= globalThis.__soJ11ChatBefore + 1) throw new Error('no reply after the fallback'); return { decision, record: last };

checks.goal: player mode shows nothing judge-internal: no probabilities, no judge sources, no steering controls
judge settings survive a reload, and the key appears nowhere in extension settings or chat metadata

steps.eval: const settings = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getGlobalSettings().judge; if (!settings.enabled || !settings.uses.director) throw new Error(`judge settings lost on reload: ${JSON.stringify(settings)}`); const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const dump = JSON.stringify(ctx.extensionSettings['story-orchestrator']) + JSON.stringify(ctx.chatMetadata ?? {}); if (/typesafe_api_key|TYPESAFE_API_KEY|Bearer /.test(dump)) throw new Error('a key reference leaked into settings or chat metadata'); const suspicious = [...dump.matchAll(/"[^"]*(?:key|secret|token)[^"]*"\s*:\s*"([^"]{24,})"/gi)].map((match) => match[0].slice(0, 40)); if (suspicious.length) throw new Error(`long secret-like values stored: ${suspicious.join(' | ')}`); return { settings };
